question: Can earlier graph selection leave time for verified routing and common curve refinement within the unchanged ten-second request?

savedCorpusFinding.counterexample: The bibel-star-outline coarse graph has 5070 binaries and 107 guide portals; later recovery graphs have 708/744/834 binaries. A separate y-minus-1 fixture uses 2544 binaries in failed coarse routing versus 1380 in later recovery.

arms.sparse-first: Within the existing coarse allowance, try at most 0.8 seconds and half the remaining time with no guide portals and eight neighbours. Retain the existing guided graph for the rest of that same allowance. All objective coefficients and geometry tolerances remain unchanged.
arms.detailed-first: Move the unchanged coarse portfolio after ordinary detailed recovery. If detailed recovery succeeds, do not spend time on the coarse fallback. If it fails and time remains, the same coarse portfolio is still eligible.

caseQualification: The two routing fixtures are perturbations of one source and may share the original real-abf photo motif; cases are not counted as independent photographs. The real-photo mask is scored against the frozen production-derived mask, not unavailable original cutting paths.
timing: Serial fresh processes, alternate arm order. Preparation and final export remain measured; independent replay is separate. No CPU overlap with full QA.
